info.name: EduFlow API
info.description:
EduFlow — backend for an Algerian lycée CS section.

**Start here:** run `Auth > Login` first. It stores the access token in a collection variable, and every other request inherits it automatically.

Seeded dev accounts (dev profile only):
- admin/teacher — `prof@eduflow.dz`
- student — `amira@eduflow.dz`

98 endpoints, generated from the live OpenAPI spec.
